original.prompt: Consider the following statements about India-Italy relations as of May 2026:
items: In May 2026, the two countries elevated their relations to a Special Strategic Partnership at a meeting in Rome.
They set a bilateral trade target of EUR 20 billion by 2029.
Italy acts primarily as a supplier of steel and chemicals to India.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. Italy is primarily a machinery supplier to India, with machinery making up nearly 40% of its exports, while steel, electronics and chemicals are Indian exports to Italy. Bilateral trade stood at EUR 14.2 billion in 2024, so the 2029 target needs roughly 40% growth.
original.source: Prime Minister Modi and Italian Prime Minister Meloni elevated India-Italy relations to a Special Strategic Partnership in Rome on Tuesday, setting a EUR 20 billion bilateral trade target by 2029 and signing agreements on defence, critical minerals, and innovation.
